3.3.2.1-f29.accuracy_reason: In La Celestina (Tragicomedia de Calisto y Melibea), Pármeno says more than five thousand maidenheads were made and unmade on her authority. The note's 'thousands' is safe.

3.3.2.1-f35.accuracy_reason: The syrinx test of virginity and Leucippe's ordeal are in Achilles Tatius book 8 (8.6, 8.13–14), not book 6.

3.3.2.1-f41.accuracy_reason: This is Qur'an 2:223 (al-Baqara) as quoted in Riccoldo da Monte di Croce's Confutatio, which the sidenote cites.
